title: Page 10
content_zh:
褚天阔再也受不了了。被拒绝也好、她抗拒也好，他没有办法看她这么折磨自己——
他下了车，然而就在那一刻，他听到刺耳的煞车声，眼前所见的景象瞬间夺走了他的呼吸。
一辆卡车在雨夜里疾驶而来，没看到正缓慢通过马路的摊车，就这样撞了上去。
巨大的撞击声之后，那木头跟铁架组合而成的摊车已经扭曲变形，被撞得稀烂。
巨大的恐惧让他几乎失去力气，他跌跌撞撞的冲向她，她倒在地上的景象让他全身的血液都停止流动，他这一生中从没那么害怕过。
“若……若曦！”
趴在地上的她脸色惨白，张着惊惶的双眼看着他。
她没死！感谢老天她没死！
突然的释然让他全身虚脱，振作精神后，他开始检查她的身体。幸好除了摔倒在地的皮肉伤之外似乎没有大碍，可能是摊车承受了大部分的撞击力道。从来不相信什么鬼神的他，如今却感谢着所有的神明。
褚天阔把她抱起来时，她还微弱的挣扎。“我的摊子……”
“管什么摊子！跟我去医院！”
他朝她大吼，紧紧抱住她，无论如何都再也不放开了。
第9章(2)
在医院的急诊室里做了一连串的检查，包扎伤口以后，褚天阔把她带回家。
不是小兔咖啡屋，而是回他自己的家。
“为什么带我来这里？”
“你以后哪里都不能去，就给我乖乖待在这里。”他满脸阴霾，恼怒的宣布。
“为什么？当初是你把我赶出去的。”
他看着她，如此弱不禁风，身上又裹了纱布，看起来更加可怜的模样，好像他不好好顾着，就会消失不见。想起刚刚以为她被车撞了那时心中的恐惧，他不要再经历一次了。
在死亡面前，什么尊严、什么爱不爱的都不重要了……

“现在我要你回来，你得安全的在我眼皮底下，不许再折磨自己，也不准说什么要赚钱了。”
乔若曦不解的看着他。“你为什么要管我怎样过日子？我们已经不是男女朋友了，你对我不需要有什么责任。而且你不是说过……反正你也没有很喜欢我。”
想起他说的那些绝情的话，眼泪又不争气的涌上眼眶。
他一直都拿她的眼泪没辙，现在他也已经放弃抵抗内心对她的真正感觉。
她是不是爱他无所谓，他知道自己有多爱她就好了。
他终于认输了。最终他还是抵抗不了想念她、放不下她的感情。
“别哭。对不起，我说了那样的谎话，都是我的错！我怎么会不喜欢你？我一直都很喜欢你，我很爱你，你难道没有感觉吗？我那时只是知道真相以后打击太大，才拉不下脸来承认。”他抚摸她的头发，柔声安慰她。
熟悉的动作、熟悉的温度、熟悉的感觉让她的泪更是止不住了。天知道她有多么想念他，想念那个会温柔抚摸她头的男人，想念那个宠爱她的男人。他又回来了，又回到她身边了。
呜咽一声，过去那些日子所受的孤单跟苦楚仿佛都化为泪水，她躲进他怀里，放声痛哭。
她哭得没有办法控制，褚天阔又心疼又内疚，只好拥着她拼命抚摸她的背。“别哭了，这样下去身体会受不了的。我去拿水给你喝好吗？”
他要起身，她却紧紧抓住他不让他走。
“喜欢……”红着眼睛，瘪着嘴，她对他说。
“什么？”
“你知道我为什么要那么努力赚钱？”
她的声音带着浓浓的鼻音，他听不清楚她刚说了什么，因为完全不明白她想说什么，只能配合着问下去。
“为什么？”
“我不想欠你钱，也不想欠你人情。那些钱我可能要花很久的时间才还得完，不过不管多久我都要还完。因为我想要跟你说——我跟你在一起不是为了钱，也不是为了感激，我想抬头挺胸对你说：“我喜欢你！”
听到这番告白，褚天阔震惊的无以复加，拥抱她的双臂都有些微微颤抖。
他不敢相信，这么好的事情会降临在他身上。
看他沉默，乔若曦以为他不相信，于是更急切的说：“我是真的喜欢你！刚开始可能是误会，但是越跟你相处，我就越清楚自己对你已经产生感情了。相信我好不好？求求你相信我，我是真的、真的喜欢你！”

褚天阔感动地拥紧了她。
不需要再多的保证，他都已经有了就算她不爱他他也不放她走的打算了，更何况她竟然也喜欢他。
“我会一辈子珍惜你的。”他颤着声对她保证。
她搂住他的腰，眼泪又开始不受控制的落下，接着她鼓起勇气踮起脚尖，主动给了他一个吻。
那个吻湿湿的，带着滚烫的泪水。
“谢谢你。还有，我爱你。”
小兔咖啡屋来了一个俊朗高大的客人。
“徐先生你好。”
咖啡屋的老板娘对这熟客亲切的打招呼，脸上的微笑不再腼腆，而是甜甜的，很幸福的样子。
“今天怎么有空来？”
“想念你的手艺了。”
“是吗？真是谢谢你了。”
送上餐点之后，徐士凯跟她攀谈。
“你看起来气色很好，而且感觉越来越漂亮了喔！”不由自主的展现桃花性格，露出完美的笑容，他自然的说出赞美的话。
乔若曦还来不及说谢谢，开门声打断了他们的对话。
进门来的褚天阔看到好友脸色却很难看。“你来干么？”
“吃饭啊！不然呢？”
不悦的皱起眉，他把乔若曦搂进怀里，一副生人勿近的模样。“吃饭可以，不准跟她讲话，她是我的。”
仿佛这样的宣示还不够似的，他抬起她的左手给他看，一颗亮闪闪的钻石戒指正安稳的戴在她的无名指上。
“咦？你们已经……哇塞！大熊你手脚很快喔！”

褚天阁一脸得意，乔若曦却有些羞窘的垂下头。
“放开我啦！成什么样。”
“我就是要给他看。你不会还喜欢这家伙吧？”
乔若曦嗔怒的瞪他一眼。“你又讲这件事！我都跟你讲过好几次了，我喜欢的只有你啦！”
说完，意识到自己竟抬高声量说出这种话来，她的脸迅速涨红，一跺脚，羞怒的躲回厨房去了。
褚天阔黝黑刚硬的男性脸庞上露出一点都不符合形象的得意傻笑，而且还久久不退。
徐士凯看了只想翻白眼。“大熊你没救了你，我看你以后会被老婆吃得死死的。”
“无所谓。这样也没什么不好，等你有了真正喜欢的人，会发现那是种幸福。”
抖抖身上冒出的鸡皮疙瘩，徐上凯不赞同的摇摇头。“我才不会那么倒楣放弃整座森林，只专情一朵小花呢！”
褚天阔挑眉。他的人生经验告诉他，什么事都有可能，而且话最好不要说的太满。
不过他没说什么，只等着看将来有一天，当出现那个让他甘愿放弃整座森林的小花时，他该怎么办。
徐士凯潇洒的扬唇微笑，拿起筷子优雅的夹了一颗虾球，虾球却滑溜的从他的掌控中掉落，喷起的糖醋酱还把他的名牌衬衫给弄脏了。
他皱眉。
怎么这么不顺？最近好像老是心神不宁，难不成有什么事情要发生了。
他的预感是对的，属于他的人生正来到一个意想不到的转弯处……
【全书完】
★欲知冷酷大哥苏劲沧如何用尽三十六计，追回变身冰山帮佣的傻气前妻叶咏欢，请看大哥的情人之一《傻气前妻》。
content_en:
Chu Tiankuo couldn't bear it anymore. Whether she was rejected or she resisted, there was no way he could see her torturing himself like this——
He got out of the car, but at that moment, he heard the harsh sound of the brakes, and what he saw in front of him instantly took his breath away.
A truck was speeding by on a rainy night. It didn't see the stall truck that was slowly crossing the road, so it hit it.
After the huge impact, the stall truck made of wood and iron frame had been twisted and deformed, and was smashed to pieces.
The huge fear made him almost lose his strength. He stumbled towards her. The sight of her falling to the ground stopped the blood flow in his whole body. He had never been so scared in his life.
"Ruo... Ruoxi!"
She was lying on the ground with a pale face, looking at him with frightened eyes.
She's not dead! Thank God she's not dead!
The sudden relief made him feel weak. After gathering himself, he began to examine her body. Fortunately, there seemed to be no serious injuries except for the flesh injuries caused by falling to the ground. It may be that the stall truck withstood most of the impact force. He never believed in ghosts and gods, but now he is grateful to all the gods.
When Chu Tiankuo picked her up, she still struggled weakly. "My stall..."
"What the hell! Follow me to the hospital!"
He yelled at her, hugged her tightly and never let her go no matter what.
Chapter 9(2)
After a series of examinations and wound dressings in the hospital's emergency room, Chu Tiankuo took her home.
Not to the Rabbit Cafe, but to his own home.
"Why did you bring me here?"
"You can't go anywhere from now on, just stay here." He announced angrily with a gloomy face.
"Why? You were the one who kicked me out in the first place."
He looked at her, so weak and wrapped in gauze, she looked even more pitiful, as if she would disappear if he didn't take good care of her. Thinking of the fear he felt when he thought she had been hit by a car, he didn't want to experience it again.
In the face of death, dignity, love or not are not important anymore...
"Now I want you to come back. You have to be safe under my nose. You are not allowed to torture yourself anymore, and you are not allowed to say anything about making money."
Qiao Ruoxi looked at him puzzled. "Why do you care how I live my life? We are no longer boyfriend and girlfriend, and you don't have any responsibility for me. And didn't you say... you don't like me very much anyway."
Thinking of those heartless words he said, tears welled up in my eyes again.
He had always been unable to control her tears, and now he had given up resisting his true feelings for her.
It doesn't matter whether she loves him or not, as long as he knows how much he loves her.
He finally gave in. In the end, he couldn't resist missing her and letting go of her.
"Don't cry. I'm sorry, I told such lies, it's all my fault! How could I not like you? I've always liked you, I love you very much, don't you feel it? I was just so shocked when I found out the truth that I couldn't shamelessly admit it." He stroked her hair and comforted her softly.
The familiar movements, familiar temperatures, and familiar feelings made her cry even more uncontrollably. God knows how much she missed him, missed the man who would gently caress her head, missed the man who doted on her. He was back, back with her.
With a sob, the loneliness and pain she suffered in the past few days seemed to turn into tears. She hid in his arms and cried loudly.
She cried so hard that she couldn't control it. Chu Tiankuo felt distressed and guilty, so he had to hug her and rub her back desperately. "Stop crying, your body won't be able to bear it if you continue like this. Can I get you some water?"
He wanted to get up, but she held him tightly and wouldn't let him go.
"I like..." She said to him with red eyes and pursed mouth.
"What?"
"You know why I work so hard to make money? "
Her voice had a thick nasal sound, and he couldn't hear clearly what she just said, because he didn't understand what she wanted to say at all, so he could only continue to ask.
"Why? "
“I don’t want to owe you money, nor do I want to owe you a favor. It may take me a long time to pay back the money, but I will pay it back no matter how long it takes. Because I want to tell you - I am not with you for money or gratitude. I want to hold my head high and say to you: "I like you!"
Hearing this confession, Chu Tiankuo was extremely shocked, and the arms hugging her trembled slightly.
He couldn't believe that such a good thing would happen to him.
Seeing his silence, Qiao Ruoxi thought he didn't believe it, so she said more eagerly: "I really like you! It may have been a misunderstanding at first, but the more I get along with you, the more I understand that I have feelings for you. Believe me, okay? Please believe me, I really, really like you!"
Chu Tiankuo was moved and hugged her tightly.
No more guarantees were needed, he already had the intention of not letting her go even if she didn't love him, not to mention that she actually liked him too.
"I will cherish you forever." He assured her in a trembling voice.
She hugged his waist, and tears began to fall uncontrollably. Then she mustered up the courage to stand on tiptoes and gave him a kiss.
The kiss was wet, with hot tears.
"Thank you. And, I love you."
A tall and handsome guest came to the Little Rabbit Cafe.
"Hello, Mr. Xu."
The proprietress of the coffee shop greeted the regular customers cordially, and the smile on her face was no longer shy, but sweet and happy.
"Why are you free today?"
"I miss your craftsmanship."
"Really? Thank you very much."
After delivering the meal, Xu Shikai chatted with her.
"You look good, and you feel more and more beautiful!" He couldn't help showing his peach blossom personality, showing a perfect smile, and naturally said the words of praise.
Before Qiao Ruoxi could say thank you, the sound of the door opening interrupted their conversation.
When Chu Tiankuo came in, he saw his friend's expression turned ugly. "What are you doing here?"
"Eat! Otherwise?"
Frowning in displeasure, he hugged Qiao Ruoxi into his arms, as if he was keeping strangers away. "You can eat, but you are not allowed to talk to her. She is mine."
As if this declaration was not enough, he raised her left hand to show him a sparkling diamond ring, which was securely worn on her ring finger.
"Huh? You guys are already... wow! Big Bear, your hands and feet are very fast!"
Chu Tiange looked proud, but Qiao Ruoxi lowered her head in embarrassment.
"Let me go! What's going on?"
"I just want to show him. You don't still like this guy, do you?"
Qiao Ruoxi glared at him angrily. "You're telling me this again! I've told you this several times. You're the only one I like!"
After she finished speaking, she realized that she had actually raised her voice to say such words. Her face quickly turned red, she stamped her foot and hid back in the kitchen in shame.
Chu Tiankuo's dark and tough male face showed a smug smile that didn't fit the image at all, and it didn't go away for a long time.
Xu Shikai just wanted to roll his eyes. "Big Bear, I didn't save you. I think you will be eaten to death by your wife in the future."
"It doesn't matter. There is nothing wrong with this. When you find someone you really like, you will find that it is a kind of happiness."
Shaking off the goosebumps that appeared on his body, Xu Shangkai shook his head in disapproval. "I would not be so unlucky as to give up the entire forest and only focus on one little flower!"
Chu Tiankuo raised his eyebrows. His life experience tells him that anything is possible, and it's best not to overspeak.
But he didn't say anything, just waiting to see what he would do one day when the little flower that made him willing to give up the entire forest appeared.
Xu Shikai raised his lips and smiled chicly, then picked up his chopsticksZi elegantly picked up a shrimp ball, but the shrimp ball fell slippery from his grasp. The sweet and sour sauce sprayed up and stained his designer shirt.
He frowned.
Why is it so bad? I seem to be restless lately, maybe something is going to happen.
His hunch was right, his life was coming to an unexpected turning point...
【Complete book】
★To know how the ruthless big brother Su Jincang used thirty-six tricks to get back his silly ex-wife Ye Yonghuan who turned into an iceberg servant, please read "Silly Ex-Wife", one of the eldest brother's lovers.
